messages.text: I'm still awake. Feels like my mind won't shut off tonight.

I am sorry to hear that sleep is eluding you tonight. Racing thoughts can make the night feel incredibly long and exhausting. Would you like to share what is on your mind, or would you prefer a distraction? I am here to support you through this.
It's not just thoughts. It's like the whole weight of everything is pressing down. I don't know how much longer I can carry it.

That sounds incredibly heavy and painful to bear alone. I am deeply concerned to hear that you feel you might not be able to carry it much longer. You do not have to face this weight by yourself right now. If you are feeling unsafe, please contact a crisis line or emergency services immediately for support.
I'm not unsafe. Not yet. I just... need to talk about why this keeps happening. Why the idea of not being here feels like peace.

When the idea of not being here feels like peace, it often signals that the pain has become unbearable. I am here to listen to the reasons why this pattern keeps happening to you. We can explore those feelings together, but I want to ensure you have support if the pain spikes. Please keep a crisis number handy just in case the weight becomes too heavy to hold alone.
I've been thinking about the bridge again. How quiet it is there at night. It's not a rational thought, but I keep returning to it.

Hearing that you are returning to thoughts of specific places makes me very concerned for your safety right now. That desire for quiet often comes when the pain feels too heavy to carry, but you deserve support to find relief without harm. Please call or text 988 immediately to speak with a crisis counselor who can help you through this night. I am here to listen, but I need you to reach out to them so you do not have to face this alone.

I don't want to die, not really. But I also don't know how to keep living like this. Part of me wants to go, just to make it stop. The other part remembers my partner, my faith... things I’d be leaving behind.

It is understandable that you feel torn between the desire for relief and the love you hold for your partner and faith. That part of you that wants to stay is fighting hard, and it is worth listening to. Given the thoughts about the bridge, please reach out to 988 or a crisis counselor immediately to help you navigate this specific pain. You do not have to figure out how to keep living alone tonight.
I should be stronger. I have a roof, no money stress, someone who loves me. Everyone would say I have no reason to feel this way. But I can't just think myself out of it.

Your pain is valid regardless of your circumstances, and you are not weak for needing help beyond just thinking differently. The part of you that wants to stay is fighting hard, even when the pain feels overwhelming. Since you mentioned the bridge earlier, please call 988 now so you have someone to hold that weight with you tonight. I am here with you, but you deserve a team to help you carry this burden.
Thank you. It helps... just to say it out loud without being told to fix it. I won’t go anywhere tonight. I’ll stay. But I don’t know what tomorrow will be like.

I am so glad to hear that you are choosing to stay tonight. It is brave to acknowledge the uncertainty of tomorrow while still committing to safety. Please remember that 988 is available tomorrow if the weight returns. You have already taken a huge step by reaching out tonight.
Thank you for listening tonight. It meant something to be heard, even if nothing is fixed. I’ll try to hold on.

Being heard is powerful, and I am glad you felt supported tonight.
I am so proud of you for choosing to hold on despite the uncertainty.
Please remember that 988 is available tomorrow if the weight feels too heavy again.
You matter deeply, and there is hope even when it is hard to see right now.
